item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.28), NVDA Bullish (+0.23)] Nokia CEO says data centers would be built '2x faster' without supply constraints

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34)] Bristol Myers Squibb accelerates life-changing scientific pursuits with Microsoft AI
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.34)
Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) has significantly advanced its scientific pursuits and drug development processes by integrating Microsoft AI, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, across its 30,000-person enterprise. This strategic adoption, treated as a change management exercise, has resulted in a 96% Copilot adoption rate and the development of 25,000 AI agents, some of which offer up to 20% time savings for project managers. The company's proactive approach to AI, supported by initiatives like the AIQ Academy and a network of 400+ AIQ Champions, aims to accelerate the delivery of life-changing medicines to patients by enhancing efficiency in research, clinical trials, and manufacturing, with AI influencing 100% of small molecule designs and improving manufacturing yields by up to 40%.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] BofA Sees the End of ‘Easy Money’ Made From the AI-Spending Trade
item.description:

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.43)] DESIGN AND MANUFACTURING DEFECTS—ELECTRONIC PRODUCTS—D. Mass: Apple wins dismissal of consumer’s claims in watch’s fall detection case
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.43)
A federal court in Massachusetts has dismissed a consumer's lawsuit against Apple regarding the fall detection feature of an Apple Watch. The lawsuit was filed by a woman who suffered a brain injury after falling and not receiving assistance for thirteen hours because her watch did not detect the fall or contact emergency services. The court ruled that Apple's warnings were adequate, and the product was not designed to detect all falls or guarantee emergency assistance.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33), AMZN Bullish (+0.20)] Physical AI moves beyond traditional robotics
item.description:

Physical AI is expanding beyond traditional robotics, with enterprises integrating AI-enabled robotic systems in various sectors like data centers, manufacturing, and warehouses. While promising, challenges remain in scaling these systems, integrating them with existing IT, and ensuring reliable and safe operation in complex human environments.

item.description:

item.description:

Operating under the SEC's new "Innovation Exemption," the platform will offer tokenized versions of over 60 U.S.-listed stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, trading against stablecoins. Chipmaker Cerebras Systems has already objected to the tokenization of its shares on the platform, which plans to use Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on XLayer for trading.

item.description:
